draft.subject: Getting Pioneer Group started in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Isla,

Thanks again for flagging the notification badge count — that one's resolved on our end, so do tell me if it crops up again.

Now that it's out of the way, the easiest next step is your first project. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so getting one up makes everything else fall into place. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through setting up that first project with you and answer anything else.

Best,
Nadia
